content: Mukwa-wileged, Bab-Dummadga-mani-uksad
Jesús Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi sigua, daksigusad, dule-mani-ibgan mani-urbed-ulu-yagi Bab-Dummadga mani urbenonidamalad.
Degi, mukwa-wileged-wargwen, ei-sui-burgwisad, mani-esnon-gwabo egwachamogad, daksabalid.
Jesús sogded: —Napira an bemarga soged, we-mukwa-wileged, ei-sui-burgwisad, we bur bule dulemar-baiganba mani uksad.
Ar baigan Bab-Dummadga-mani-uksaddi, gwabgusad uksamalad. We-mukwadi e-wilesaa-gudiidgine, belagwapa e-mani-bukwad uknonikid.
Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-ayaroedgi Jesús sunmaksad
Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-sobaledgi dulemar sunmakbukmalad, e-akwamar yeerdakleye, degine, dulemar a-neg-yeerdaklegega-ibmar-uksamalad yeerdaklebarye. Agi, Jesús sogded:
—Ar bemar weyob we-negdakedi, ibagan nonikoed, bipisaale akwa-gwagwensaar birgi-birgi bar sigosulid, bela ayaroed.
Napaneg-bergued-iduar-neg-guoedgi Jesús sunmaksad
Jesús-sapingan, Jesúsʼse egichiarmalad: —Odurdaked-saila, ¿sana degite, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg ayarosunna? We-ibagan-mosar, ¿igi-neg-gudagosunna?

Geb degi, Jesús sogded: “Nue salakarmar, mer dulemarse yardaklemalo. Ar bukidar yamo anyob imaknonimaloed, sognonimaloed: ‘Ani an Cristo, Bab-Dummad-dule-wargwen-barmidagoye-sogsad-duleye.’ Degine, sognonimarbaloed: ‘Neg nue-dukumossunye.’ Degi-inigwele, mer eba be nagumalo.

”Bila-onogedginbi neg-naguar be itodamaloed, degi, neg-urwedgibi naguar be itodamarbaloed. Deyob neg-gualile, mer be dobgumalo. Ar we-ibmarmar-inse guergebed, degi-inigwele, neg bato emiskwaa berguodeeye soglesulid.”
Geb degi, Jesús amarga sogdebar: “Dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmalad na bila ononanai gudamaloed, degi, reymar na muchub-muchub egi yolenanai gudamarbaloed.

Degine, negabandur-dummagan nagumai gudagoed. Yar-baid-baidgi ukud-dummad, degi, uellemalad-bukidar-ainimai gudabaloed. Dobed-dummad nagumai, degine, nibneggi ibmarmar-wilubgan-dakledisulid-dummagan oyolemai gudagoed.

”Ar bela we-ibagan-bulegan-iduale, dulemar bemar-baregindamaloed, bemar-gamaloed, degine, Judíoʼmar-onmakednegse bemar-sedmaloed, esgaryagi bemar-metemaloed. Ar bemar, an-sapinganga gumalad-ulale, reymar-asabin, degi, dummagan-negdakmamaid-asabin bemar-sedmaloed.
”Ar deyob ibmarmar-guoedi, adi, bemar angi sunmakegalad.
Degisoggu, mer bai-itomalo, mer be binsamalo, an na san bendakegala, ¿igi an sogodibeye?
Ar ani an bega binsaed-nued ukoed igi be sogoe. Bela dulemar-begi-gwisgudimalad begi obinosurmalad, ar ade, geg be-abinsae gumaloed.
”Ar be-babganse-bakar, be-ukmaloed, be-iamar, be-urbamar, be-gwenadgan, be-aimar, dummaganga be-ukmaloed, degine, gwen-gwen bemar oburgwilemaloed.
Be an-sapinganga-gumalad-ulale, bela-dulemar isdar be-dakmaloed.
Ar degi-inigwele, be sailagia-wargwensaar bei gwen yogguosulid.
Ar bemar galakusulile, be abonolemaloed.
”Ar bemar dakalir, sorda-bila-onomalad Jerusalén-ebiris bukwa, be wismardo, we-Jerusalén-neggwebur-bibisged-ibagan warmaknoniki.
Degisoggu, a-ibagi, Judeaʼgi be gudiile, yalaganba be wakinno. Bemar-Jerusalén-neggwebur-abargi-gudiile, be nomalo, degine, bemar-sapurba-gudimalale, mer bar neggweburse dagmalo.
”Ar a-ibagangine, Bab-Dummadi dulemar-e-sogedba-nanadisurmalad sabsur-odurdakoed. Ar igi Bab-Dummad-Gardagi-narmakar-nai, deyobi guoed.

Degine, a-ibagangine, ammormar-gurgin-nikagudimalad, degi, mimmigan-gwaru-sedimalad, nue-wilemaloed. Ar ade, a-ibagangi we-napneggi ibagan-nunmak-itoleged naiguoed. Degine, Bab-Dummad we-dulemargi nue-odurdaked-dummad nasikoed.

”Degine, dulemar es-suidgi-ewarar burgwemaloed. Deginbali, galesmalad bela neggwebur-bamaladse seledmaloed. Degine, dule-Judíoʼsurmalad, Jerusalén-neggwebur nue-wiononimaloed. We-dulemar, Jerusalénʼgi-gudigumaloed-e-ibagan-berguoedse, deyob-gudii gumaloed.”
Jesús gannar-e-danikoedgi sunmaksad

Jesús sogdebar: “Geb degine, dad-ibelergi wilubgan dakledagoed, niigi, degine, niisgwamargi wilubgan dakledagoed. Degine, napneggi dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmalad demar-uurmakedba, degi, demar-arwedba, surbinsa itodamaloed.
Dulemar-bukidar dobedba, degine, ibmar-dummagan we-napneggi-akar-gudagoedba negoedmaloed. Ar ade, nibneggi ibmar-dummagan gala-nika-nanaid bela giglimakoed.
”Geb degine, ani Dule-Machi, mogir-imbaba an-ganguedba, degi, bela-bela an-gangued-yeerdaklegedba-dani an-dakdamaloed.
Ar ibmar-wegiimalad deyob guar be dakele, gandik be samalo, degi, na be guakwaa gudigumalo. Ar ade, be-san-burba-abonoleged-ibagan warmaksad.”
Degi, Jesús na e-sapinganga burbar sogdebalid: “Nue be higuera-sapi, degi, sapi-baigan, be dakmar.
Wegi anmar-yargi sapimar bato gannar aramaksale, bemar nue wisid, yor omodaniki.
Amba deyobmodo, we-ibmarmar an-bemarga-sogsamaladi, deyob guar bemar dakalir, bemar wisdo, Bab-Dummad-e-negdakmaid bato warmakdaniki.
”Napira an bemarga soged, we-dulemar-dula-gudimalad-burgwed-idu, we-ibmarmar bela guedsegad.
Nibnega, degi, napnega bela berguoed, ar an-gayaburbadi berguosulid, degisadeguoed.

”Bemargi na be-dukin salakarmarmo. Mer mas-gunnedginbi be binsadii gumalo. Degine, mumguedginbi, degi, we-napneggi-ibmar-naidginbi mer binsadii be gumalo. Ar degiile, abakalegi, bemar we-ibagan-edarbedisulid ukiarmakale bemargi danikile.
”Ar igi ibmar-durgan ibmar-galegedgi ukiar galedae, deyobi, we-ibagan bela-dulemar-we-napneggi-bukmaladgi ukiar nonikoed.

Degisoggu, nue neg-itoagwar be gudii gumar. Gatik Bab-Dummadse gordii gumar. Adi, bemar unnitiba we-ibmar-gudagoedgi be wakinmalagar, degine, a-ibagangi, Dule-Machi-asabin gwage-swilidik gwichigumogagar.”
Jesús, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi bane-bane neg-ibgi dulemar-odurdakdii gualid, degine, neg-mutikdi, Olivosʼye-yar-nugadse naddaed.
Degine, bela dulemar neg-wakdar Bab-Dummadse-goled-negse, Jesúsʼse e-odurdaked-itogega nonidamalad.
